SFUSD assigns schools after application using its rules and available seats; neither proximity nor an elementary attendance area reserves a seat. 在读学生想换校，应查适用的转校流程；Spring Transfer 面向符合条件: Current students seeking another school should check the applicable transfer process. Spring Transfer serves eligible current SFUSD students and excludes charter-school students. A successful assignment automatically replaces the previous placement; it is not an exploratory request that you can accept or decline later. For attendance across district boundaries, check interdistrict permits with both the district of residence and the receiving district.
